target_customer: Online resellers who list on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Etsy and similar marketplaces
problem: Reselling across several marketplaces means re-entering listings and delisting sold items by hand, which is slow and causes double sales.
business_model: SaaS subscription for resellers priced by listing volume ($8.99 to $149.99 per month in 2021)
product_category: E-commerce crosslisting and inventory software for resellers

founders.name: Thomas Rivas
founders.background_notes: YC page: online seller since 2008 with some development experience; he conceived the product from his own crossposting need.

founders.name: Chris Amador
founders.background_notes: Named CTO in a February 2021 MarTech article; not listed on the YC page.

founders.name: Josh Dzime-Assison
founders.background_notes: YC page: full-time reseller 15+ years and image consultant for musicians and athletes.

founders.name: Ben Martinez
founders.background_notes: Leads customer support per YC page; COO per MarTech.

investors: Individual investor from the footwear business in the Baltimore area

competitors.name: List Perfectly
competitors.what: Crosslisting tool for Poshmark, eBay, Mercari, Depop, Etsy and others; founded 2017 per its listing

technical_complexity.rationale: Crossposting depends on automating marketplaces without public APIs, which breaks when sites change, but the problem is standard web automation.

defensibility.rationale: Customer inventory and listing data create some lock-in, but rivals offer the same function and marketplaces can change access.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Marketplaces did not copy crosslisting as far as found; no acquisition found. Vendoo claims 81000 resellers on its site.

market_need_then: The reselling industry grew during Covid-19 as people sought income through reselling (MarTech, February 2021); Vendoo made about 30000 dollars in revenue in its first month, January 2020.

identity.voice_and_tone: Approachable; tagline A Seller's Best Friend

branding.community_and_virality: Press from FreightWaves, Technical.ly and MarTech in 2021; reseller content marketing blog. No merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Well known in the reseller community with press coverage and a vendor blog, but no iconic brand asset found.

outcome_analysis: Vendoo bootstrapped a crosslisting tool for resellers, launched in January 2020 after a 2019 beta, and reached about 30000 dollars revenue in its first month. Strong early revenue let it avoid another round, and it reports 55 staff and over 81000 resellers. Founders were resellers themselves, and Covid boosted the reselling market.
notes: Aggregators conflict: CB Insights 650K over 2 rounds; PitchBook 125K; one ZoftwareHub page 500K seed March 2022; a less established outlet says 300K at the end of 2019. All unverified and excluded. The 400K figure is from MarTech (February 2021) and has no date or round label, so stage is other. List Perfectly source is an undated third-party page; no dated pre-batch source for competitors was found and MarTech and Technical.ly named none. YC page and the MarTech piece differ on founder roles (YC lists three founders; Amador added from MarTech and Technical.ly). Founding year 2017 per CB Insights and press search results; HQ conflict between DC and Silver Spring. No acquisition or layoff news for Vendoo found; results were other companies.
